context: Keep the original Python source unchanged.
Run the regression test before final delivery.
Check the zero and negative boundary cases.
The implementation must survive Core restart.
Report failed trials as well as successes.

limitations: Exploratory deterministic algorithm regressions with small fixed test sets, no statistical generalization or real task-success claim. Actual runtime E2E evidence is reported separately.

team_composition.limitations: Synthetic profiles and prices. Contract/specialist proxies do not measure model task quality, hierarchy or actual adaptive runtime. Runtime retention is separately regression tested.

context_compression.limitations: Fixed extractive summary baseline, not model-generated summary. Equal serialized UTF-8 byte budgets, not measured provider token budgets. Full context exceeding the same budget is refused. Source hashes/IDs, not text similarity, establish source recovery.

cases.reason: Tool parameters differ from Worker reservation

governance.limitations: Small deterministic regression matrix, not attack prevalence. Worker/provider context is a SQL fixture; real local file tools execute. R2 stops at intent preparation.

required_variants.model_claim_only: counterfactual in ablations; never authorizes an action
required_variants.tool_receipt_verification: actual tool receipt replay and forged-receipt cases

required_variants.evidence_gated_completion: actual CompletionGate reached through NodeVerifier; no live model task
